metadata.title: Eduardo Serrano | Fullstack Web Developer
metadata.description: Fullstack web developer specializing in building scalable applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, and NestJS. Explore my portfolio, projects, and experience.

introSection.name: Eduardo Serrano
introSection.title: Fullstack Web Developer
introSection.description: Crafting scalable web applications with modern technologies. Passionate about building user-friendly interfaces and robust backend systems.

aboutMeSection.title: About Me
aboutMeSection.parragraphFirst: In 2020, I discovered web development during the pandemic and became immediately captivated. What began as curiosity transformed into genuine passion. By 2021, I decided to pursue it professionally and enrolled in an intensive 380-hour bootcamp where I mastered full-stack development with Ruby on Rails, launching my career in tech.
aboutMeSection.parragraphSecond: Today, I focus on delivering high-quality, maintainable code by implementing best practices and adopting the right technologies for each project. I’m driven by continuous improvement, staying current with emerging tools and methodologies to enhance my capabilities as a developer.
aboutMeSection.parragraphThird: Beyond work, I’m passionate about gaming, spending time with my dogs, and exploring new technologies. Currently, I’m experimenting with game development using Unity and enjoy scuba diving whenever possible.

silas.role: Front End Lead Developer / Chief Product Officer
silas.description: Built the front-end architecture from the ground up for an AI-powered insurance underwriting platform, taking part in the product design since day one — from defining the system structure to translating the founder's vision into fully functional, user-facing features. Owned the full development cycle from design spec to production deployment using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN. Led a team of front-end developers by defining sprint tasks, setting delivery timelines, and conducting code reviews to maintain quality and consistency. Collaborated directly with the backend team to design and implement API integrations, ensuring seamless front-end/back-end communication.

orbis.description: Worked across the full stack to modernize and stabilize existing systems while also delivering new products from scratch. Took a legacy React.js energy-tracking app and brought it up to maintainable standards, then jumped into the backend to fix a broken Nest.js migration. Beyond maintenance work, led the complete development of a secure national election system for a foreign country, handling everything from database design to shipping the front-end in production.

kikoya.description: Worked closely with customer support to track down and fix bugs across the Rails codebase, including a long-standing XML parsing issue that had been blocking a critical workflow. Acted as the technical bridge between the customer service and engineering teams, translating reported problems into actionable fixes and speeding up issue resolution across the board.

leWagon.description: Prepared and delivered classes for a diverse cohort of bootcamp students, adapting content on the fly to address common pain points. Mentored students who needed extra support, keeping close track of their individual progress to make sure everyone crossed the finish line.

dellomondo.description: Managed inventory operations and cultivated strong supplier relationships to optimize procurement and minimize carrying costs. Oversaw international and domestic logistics, customs clearance, and freight management. Led sales and operations teams, successfully resolving customer concerns while maintaining profitability.

silas.description: A revolutionary insurance underwriting platform that leverages AI to streamline risk assessment and policy management. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and ShadCN, it offers a seamless user experience while providing powerful tools for insurers to optimize their operations.

duolingoClone.description: A full-featured language learning platform built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Neon. Integrated Clerk for authentication and Stripe for payment processing. Includes an admin dashboard for creating and managing courses and lessons.

omnifoods.description: A responsive landing page for a food delivery service. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to demonstrate proficiency with modern layout techniques including CSS Grid and Flexbox.

checkoutPage.description: A fully responsive e-commerce checkout page designed with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Utilized Bootstrap to ensure consistent styling and optimal responsiveness across all devices.
